card.fires_on: Responds to a piece in the middle or end of a split-up word, such as the 'ARD' in TRIJARDY, the 'il' in Triavil, or the 'ritical' in diacritical. It also fires on the acronym DIC after 'disseminated intravascular coagulation'.
